observations: Photos show a removed vehicle transmission/gearbox assembly in a workshop setting.
The unit has a large bellhousing area and multiple ports/hoses/lines around it (typical of an automatic transmission assembly).
No clear Ford Fusion badge/label or readable part number is visible in the photos provided.
No clear engine displacement (e.g., 2.5L/1.6L/2.0L) is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show a gearbox but no readable Ford Fusion identification or matching label/part number.
No engine cylinder count or engine ID/displacement is readable in the photos.
Seller text only; photos do not show engine capacity.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment (e.g., different Ford Fusion transmission variant, or different engine/transmission pairing).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID label/plate and/or stamped code on the gearbox casing (and the VIN/engine code of the donor car).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a gearbox with unknown fitment risk (treated as not guaranteed to match).

risks.risk: Condition unknown (may be damaged internally, leaking, or missing parts).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (engaged through gears) OR a photo of fluid level/condition and any leak points; also show all included components (torque converter, cooler lines, sensors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs overhaul until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect external components (sensors, solenoids, harness connectors, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all connectors/sensors on the unit, and close-ups of the bellhousing area and any ports; confirm what is included in the package.

risks.risk: Automatic vs manual mismatch (photos suggest automatic, but not confirmable).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the selector/shift linkage area and any transmission tag indicating type.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case mismatch risk (treated as wrong type).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the transmission ID tag/label and any stamped code on the casing (so the exact transmission variant can be identified).
Photo of the full unit showing all sensors/connectors and what exactly is included (torque converter, cooler lines, harness, mounting brackets).
Video proof of operation (or at least a bench test) showing it engages properly and no major leaks.
Donor vehicle details: VIN (last 6-8 digits) and engine code/displacement (and whether it was 4-cylinder as claimed).
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox assembly, but there is no readable identification (part number/label) and no proof of fitment or working condition. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
